QuestInfo.name: A Worthy Weapon
QuestInfo.1: Anne wants to give a gift to Big Headward in return. Defeat #rAdvanced Knight Es#k, get the #bOrnate Sword#k, and give it to Big Headward.
QuestInfo.2: You gave a Cygnus Knight's sword to Big Headward.

0.0: I should give Big Headward a gift in return. But what would be good? A hat? Wait, do they even make them that big...? Oh, and he wouldn't want to hide his hair, anyway.

yes.0: Then I'll leave it to you.

no.0: Are you busy? Just talk to me whenever you need help.

0.1: Hmm. A good weapon can cover some for a lack of skill. Maybe an #bOrnate Sword#k will work.
0.2: If you wouldn't mind defeating some #rAdvanced Knight Es#k, giving the #bOrnate Sword#k to Big Headward, I'd really appreciate it. When you do, tell him to train harder so I don't have to watch over him all the time.

1.0: Did you give the bow to--what is this? Oh-hoh, an Ornate Sword. A weapon nearly as elegant as I.

yes.0: Oh, I see. Those were glares of concern and not malice. I can understand her feelings, the town would be dealt a serious blow if a talent like me wasn't able to be on security duty.
yes.1: And if she is giving me a weapon, it must mean my strength is dearly needed, right? *sigh* Alas, I have no choice. I'd planned to return to being a stylist, but if Henesys needs my power, I must comply.
yes.2: The best warriors fight with style, anyway. I will wield my style in service of my town.

item.0: Did giving the bow to Anne clear things up?

npc.0: Defeat #rAdvanced Knight Es#k, get the #bOrnate Sword#k, and give it to Big Headward.
